scenarios: user < team < repository layers with blueprints by extends; the run pins the revision it starts in; the definition rewritten under the live run leaves the run in its revision and the view stale, naming the change; a rebuild is refused while the run is in progress
proof: three layers with explicit precedence and blueprints, captured by hash as one revision with a digest at the run's start; the definition changing afterwards changes nothing for the run; staleness is a reported state of the pin against what is there.
audit: MISSING before: no environment definition, no revision, no staleness.
limitations: layers are the definition (no per-run override); values literal; a cloud task's environment is its sandbox image's.
